notes: Read all 194 numbered source lines before editing. The module is a pure, UI-agnostic React hook (useCallback/useMemo) bridging the user's settings preference to SI-floor formatters: no JSX, no DOM, no Recharts/Leaflet, no browser-only API, so it ports 1:1 to React Native. Hermes runs the same useMemo/useCallback primitives, and Intl.NumberFormat (used by the inlined formatters) is already used across the native app (UptimeHeatmap, ChartSummary, formatOperationsValue), so no DOM-only dependency is introduced.
L1 `import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'` -> `import {useCallback, useMemo} from 'react';` (react is RN-compatible; native no-inner-brace-spacing style + semicolons).

L2 `import { useSettings } from './useSettings'` targets the web app-level settings hook (returns a fully-merged `settings` object) which is NOT ported. Following the usePreferredRange/useFaviconBadge precedent, rewritten to `import {useSettings} from '../api/hooks/useSettings'` (the native query hook). Its AppSettings exposes the same snake_case unit_of_length/unit_of_temp/unit_of_pressure/locale/decimal_precision fields.

L3-19 `import { formatDistance as libFormatDistance, ... formatPower as libFormatPower, type UnitPref, type DistanceUnitPref ... type PowerUnitPref } from '../lib/unitConversion'` — that SI-floor lib is NOT ported to native. Following the ChargingHeatmapPage (`convertEnergyFromSI` inlined) + usePreferredRange/useConfirm inline precedent, the EXACT surface useUnits consumes is inlined module-locally byte-for-byte: the 7 formatters (named libFormatDistance/libFormatSpeed/libFormatTemperature/libFormatPressure/libFormatEnergy/libFormatDuration/libFormatPower, mirroring the web `as libFormatX` aliases and avoiding shadow with the hook's formatX callbacks), their 7 convertXFromSI converters, the conversion factors, the locale/precision/empty helpers, and the UnitPref + 7 per-quantity pref types. SI constants, factors, converters, DEFAULT_EMPTY_DISPLAY/DEFAULT_PRECISION and the isFiniteNumber/formatNumber/resolveEmpty/resolvePrecision helpers come from web lib/unitConversion.ts L46-419 verbatim (METERS_PER_MILE 1609.344, METERS_PER_KM 1000, METERS_PER_FOOT 0.3048, KPA_PER_PSI 6.894757, KPA_PER_BAR 100, SECONDS_PER_MINUTE/HOUR/DAY; °C identity & (c*9/5)+32; kPa/psi/bar; Wh & Wh/1000; s/min/h/d; W & W/1000; DEFAULT_PRECISION distance1 speed0 temp1 pressure1 energy2 duration0 power2; em-dash fallback). Switch-without-default exhaustive converters match the committed ChargingHeatmapPage pattern.

L21-44 the useUnits contract JSDoc is preserved, with the only edit being the `@/lib/unitConversion` references rewritten to `libFormatX inlined above` to reflect the inline (behavior/intent unchanged: reads useSettings once, exposes 7 formatters that perform NO math in the hook, returns a stable unitPrefs, memoizes over primitive deps).

L46-50 `export interface FormatOptions { precision?: number }` preserved verbatim and exported. The web lib's internal FormatOptions (lib L262-265) is structurally identical `{ precision?: number }`, so it is MERGED into this single exported FormatOptions (the inlined libFormatX reference it) — behavior-identical, avoids a duplicate-name collision in the single inlined file.

Matches the native FormatterPrefsBridge `decimal_precision ?? 2` convention.
